title: Riyadh airport attack injures 4 Filipinos, 3 in ICU

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The number of Filipinos injured in an attack at an international airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, has risen to four, with three of them confined in intensive care units (ICUs), the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said Sunday.
